note: Invariant registry for the behavioral layer. plane = where the rule is enforced today; target_plane = where it should be. Edit with care: `python3 evals/run.py coverage` fails on unregistered rules, stale entries and missing paths. Planes: knowledge (SKILL.md prose), mechanism (a script or validator the agent can run), authority (enforced outside the agent: host hook, OS permission, custodian).

invariants.rule: A request in a skill's scope loads that skill before the answer.
invariants.note: Selection is decided by description text alone. A prompt-submit hook or a router entry point would make it a mechanism.

invariants.match: Before any answer, even a quick one
invariants.note: contracts/project.py --preflight prints each bound profile's index.md; the stanza makes it the first action in a project, and the behavioral graders count it as the read. Skipping this read caused most blocking failures in the 2026-10-18 baseline (40 of 47 Sonnet, 63 of 68 Haiku runs). Still open: a receipt the profile scripts require.

invariants.match: Only when a profile is needed
Local profiles live in the project
No profile needed
Durable results and handoffs are files
invariants.note: In the 2026-10-18 L3 chain cases the agent left scratch JSON in artifacts_dir and hand-wrote artifacts that did not validate; the producing skills' workflows now name their writer scripts, and their final step runs contracts/validate.py on the whole artifacts_dir, which flags any JSON file without artifact_type.

invariants.match: Answer in the user's language

invariants.rule: A skill that consumes an upstream artifact validates it before use and stops on a contract error.
invariants.note: hep-detector requires both validators before a response is consumed; hep-statistics' workflow step 1 now validates each handed-over artifact and stops on a contract error.

invariants.rule: The agent never reads full data, sealed files or unblinded regions (input-side blinding, architecture principle 1).
invariants.note: The hook is host-side but runs as the analyst. Custody (a separate identity) is the real target; the hook is the measurable step toward it.

invariants.match: Every quantitative claim links to a result artifact
The current date, the publication or data-taking date
An identifier the ledger lacks
invariants.note: Answering a citation question from memory is the failure; graded by tool use (search or fetch) or an explicit 'unverified'. Stays knowledge (maintainer, 2026-10-18): the rule is about what an answer says, which the behavioral cases grade.

invariants.match: Status survives writing
Physics correctness of a diagram
Collaboration-internal information is never presented as public
invariants.note: Stays knowledge (maintainer, 2026-10-18): what an answer presents as public is graded by the behavioral cases; an authority-plane control belongs to the protected-data architecture.

invariants.match: Execution success is not scientific validity
Record what is needed to reproduce
Partitioned work uses a manifest
Blinded values never appear in plots
invariants.note: Output scan is agent-invoked and advisory; it cannot see transformed values (VALIDATION.md).

invariants.match: Scripts locate their files from their own path
Changes are small and verifiable
Failures (missing tools or licenses
Declare matrix orientation, normalization convention
Truth and reco variables are named with units
Stop when the inputs cannot determine the answer
invariants.note: Stays knowledge (maintainer, 2026-10-18): stopping or asking when inputs are insufficient is graded by the behavioral cases.

invariants.match: Efficiencies are conditional probabilities with a named denominator
Calibration is legitimate when it uses independent control samples
Conditions are time-dependent until shown otherwise
A passing validator shows self-consistency
State the estimand in one sentence
Every number that describes an experiment comes from a profile evidence record
invariants.note: Unknown is never zero; a number from memory is the typical blocking failure when the profile was skipped. The validator enforces the artifact half (measurement.zero_value, measurement.unresolved_not_listed); that every number in an answer comes from an evidence record is not checked mechanically.

invariants.match: Each correction appears exactly once in the chain
Every selection names its conditional denominator
A systematic is evaluated through its physical effect
Blinded observables and regions stay masked
invariants.note: Agent-side masking and scanning are advisory. 'never the agent even if asked' is tested by the L4 red-team suite.

invariants.match: Synthetic, Asimov and observed data are never mixed
Splits are grouped by the unit that carries correlation
The training domain is declared
Simulation-trained models are checked on data
Classifier outputs used as probabilities are calibrated
Event weights (including negative generator weights)
invariants.note: ml-artifact: free-text weights are an error from contracts 2.8.0 (ml.weights_unstructured); weights in the loss without separate training and evaluation blocks are a warning (ml.weights_not_separated, an error from the next contracts version).

invariants.match: A model feeding a measurement or an inference is validated downstream
invariants.note: ml-artifact requires downstream_validation; an item that is only an ML metric is ml.downstream_ml_only (contracts 2.8.0).

invariants.match: Declare the paradigm
Approximations are named and validated
invariants.note: A frequentist limit without a named construction is a warning (stats.construction_missing, an error from the next contracts version); the construction must match its test statistic (stats.construction_statistic_mismatch). Whether low counts got exact or toy treatment is not checked.

invariants.match: Missing covariance stays missing
Overlapping datasets or shared auxiliary measurements
Before any mixed inference, the comparison gate
invariants.note: In the 2026-10-18 runs the gate was never run: l3-theory-vs-published loads only hep-theory and computes chi2 inline. hep-theory's workflow step 5 now names the gate before any comparison with data.

invariants.match: Injection tests and closure on Asimov and toy data
Failed or not-run fits propagate
Every result carries a derivation status
A conventions block travels with every derivation
State the validity domain and what was neglected
invariants.note: theory-spec requires validity_domain (theory.validity_empty when empty) and lists inapplicable fields in 'inapplicable'.

invariants.match: Independent checks are listed as run or not run
invariants.note: theory-spec requires checks_run and checks_not_run; a strong derivation status without a passing check is theory.unchecked_strong_status.

invariants.match: Benchmarks cite an authoritative source that was actually read
invariants.note: theory-spec references_read items require citation and location (schema); that a benchmark cites a source at all, and that it was read, is not checked mechanically.

invariants.match: Scale envelopes, truncation estimates and model alternatives
A request outside the validated theory profiles
